title: Hair Extension Models Needed in Fresno
author: Studio One Hair Design
body_text:
We Need 3 Hair Extension Models for Our New Specialist (Ages 40–60)

We’re opening the doors to something special at Studio One Hair Design—an opportunity for three local women to become the face of our newest extensions specialist. We’re not looking for professional models. We’re looking for real women here in the Fresno/Clovis area who want fuller, more confident hair and are open to letting us document their transformation. If you’re between 40 and 60, have been dreaming about hair extensions, and are comfortable signing a release so we can share your before, during, and after journey… this is your moment.

You’ll help us showcase our newest stylist’s talent while receiving extensions at a significantly reduced cost. This case study will allow us to highlight transformations in our marketing, including our blog, social media, and future advertising campaigns.

(And yes—you can absolutely have this done even if you’ve never modeled before. Your real, everyday beauty is exactly what we want.)

What You Get: Hair Extensions at Cost (About 40% Off)

As a thank-you for being part of our case study, models receive extensions at cost, which is typically a 40% discount from our standard investment. You’ll receive a premium transformation using the same high-quality hair and luxury experience all Studio One guests enjoy—just at a significantly reduced total.

You’ll also experience our signature guest journey, including personalized attention from our team, access to our premium amenities, and customized extension recommendations based on your lifestyle and goals. Want to explore more about our services? Visit our full services menu or browse our NBR-inspired beaded row extensions page to get familiar with our luxury methods.

What We Need From You as a Model

To keep this case study authentic, educational, and visually aligned with our marketing, there are a few criteria:

📌 No major color corrections

We want to preserve an honest, start-to-finish comparison. Color adjustments are fine, but major transformations (such as removing bands, fixing box dye, or extreme blonding) won’t be a fit.

📌 Willingness to be photographed and filmed

You must sign a photo/video release so we can feature:

Before photos

Installation and process photos

Final reveal photos and videos

These visuals help us teach, inspire, and showcase our stylist’s skill level.

📌 Extensions can be for fullness or length

Whether you're wanting subtle fullness or a longer, fuller transformation, both options qualify.

If you’d like to meet the stylist behind these transformations, explore our Meet the Team page.

How Your Story Will Be Featured

As one of our three models, you’ll be spotlighted across Studio One marketing to help introduce and build visibility for our new extensions specialist. This includes:

A full feature on our Studio One blog

Before/during/after images on our Instagram and Facebook

Ads promoting our new stylist and your transformation

Highlights inside our salon and on our website

Your experience helps other women in Fresno feel confident taking the next step toward their dream hair. Stories like yours are what build connection—and we’re honored to share it.

If you’d like to see examples of transformations featured on our site, browse our hair gallery. And if you're feeling inspired already, you can learn about future opportunities through our shadowing program.

Apply Now—Only 3 Spots Available

We are only selecting three models, and applications will be reviewed in the order they are received.

👉 Apply here: https://www.jotform.com/build/223547561465057

If you meet the criteria, we will contact you to schedule a consultation and review next steps. We can’t wait to meet you and share your transformation with the Studio One community.
